messages.脚力【午】を切らさずにマッチを取り、「敵陣走破」を溜めてバリアと火力を得る、破裂: A Rupture and Tremor tank-attacker who maintains Strider【Wu】, wins Clashes, and builds Linebreaker for Shield and damage. At 5 Linebreaker, S3 becomes the multi-target Obsidian Stormrider's Crescent Decapitator. He also works with Family Hierarch Candidate Ishmael.
messages.脚力【午】(最大3): 守備「突撃前、整えん。」で次のターンに、S3「先鋒走破」: **Strider【Wu】 (maximum 3)**: Defense, Preparation Afore the Charge., grants 3 next turn; S3 Cavalry's Vanguard Charge and Obsidian Stormrider's Crescent Decapitator grant 3 on use. At Turn End, grants 2 Haste and Aggro equal to its value × 2 for the next turn. Inflicts Tremor on the main target before attacking. Its value decreases by 1 at Turn End.
messages.敵陣走破(最大5): バトルパッシブ「黒風馬脚」(暴食×5・保有・同期化Ⅱで取得: **Linebreaker (maximum 5)**: His combat passive, Obsidian Stormrider (5 Gluttony Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ), grants 1 when he wins a Clash with Strider【Wu】, starts an attack at least 2 Speed faster than his target, or triggers 2 Tremor Bursts with his own skills. Gains up to 3 per turn; Obsidian Stormrider's Crescent Decapitator cannot generate it. At Turn Start, Linebreaker grants Shield equal to its value × 10. While he has Shield, gains Defense Level equal to Shield ÷ 10, up to 5.
messages.速度と敵陣走破で強化: 自分の速度が対象より高いと各スキルが強化され、S2「月刀: **Speed and Linebreaker bonuses**: Being faster than the target improves his skills. S2 Crescent Blade Strike, with a Speed advantage of at least 2, and S3 gain damage based on Linebreaker. At 3 or more Linebreaker, all Coins on S3 become Unbreakable.
messages.「黒風馬脚月斬」: 敵陣走破が5ならS3が全て消耗してこれとして発動。4枚の破壊: **Obsidian Stormrider's Crescent Decapitator**: At 5 Linebreaker, S3 consumes it all to activate as this skill. It has 4 Unbreakable Coins and grants 1 Commanding Cry to every ally other than himself next turn. His always-active Adept Vanguard passive also grants him 3 Offense Level Up this turn and next turn when he grants Commanding Cry. If this passive has already granted him Offense Level Up, the new grant applies only next turn.
messages.家主候補イシュメールとの連携: 常時発動パッシブ「狗馬之心」により、家主候補のイ: **Family Hierarch Candidate Ishmael synergy**: With her deployed, his always-active The Steed's Houndlike Loyalty passive lets her gain 3 Poise Potency when she inflicts Rupture Potency or Count through skill effects other than E.G.O skills, up to 2 times per turn. At Turn Start, she gains 1 Attack Power Up, plus another 1 at 10 or more Poise Potency. After Obsidian Stormrider's Crescent Decapitator, she uses Crimson Spring as an Assist Attack, once per turn.
messages.序盤に守備かS3で脚力【午】を得て、攻撃スキルでマッチに勝ち敵陣走破を稼ぐ。敵陣: Start with defense or S3 to gain Strider【Wu】, then win Clashes with attack skills to build Linebreaker. It improves both his Shield and damage, so refresh Strider regularly with defense or S3. Use its Aggro to take attacks and its accumulated Shield to absorb them. At 5 Linebreaker, use Obsidian Stormrider's Crescent Decapitator to distribute Commanding Cry and gain Offense Level Up himself. Obsidian Stormrider's requirement of 5 Gluttony Owned is substantial, so other Heishou Identities with Gluttony skills help. Family Hierarch Candidate Ishmael gains Poise and Attack Power bonuses from the partnership and can follow Crescent Decapitator with an Assist Attack.
